summary: Mark Wier, 64, of Lafayette, died on a private raft trip on the Arkansas River in Browns Canyon when he and a woman went overboard near Widowmaker Rapids just before 2:30 p.m.; the woman swam to shore, Wier was pulled out and given CPR by raft occupants without success, and he was pronounced dead at the scene.
location: Widowmaker Rapids, Browns Canyon, Arkansas River
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue; Salida Fire Swift Water Rescue; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Source: American Whitewater accident record quoting KUSA-TV and the Rocky Mountain Sea Kayak Club — surfaced via the Chieftain chunk's searches, not a Chieftain item (caveat per the run-991/992 non-chunk-source precedent). KUSA text spells the surname 'Wher'; AW record and club report say 'Wier'. Inserted run 1014 (Chieftain chunk).
